title: Guided tour of the Alhambra, Nasrid palaces and the Generalife
text: We visited this beautiful place with my 2 children. Experience greatly enhanced by our guide Andy, who passes from one language to another with ease, who knows extremely well the history of the monument, the city, the Andalusian culture, who took nice photos of us. The Generalife, the Nasrid palaces are sublime. We absolutely do not regret, the game is really worth it
author: Cynthia M
